checks.message: Provisional boundary is explicit and never called official.
Three key areas remain provisional and reference areas are separated.
Proposed land-use mosaic is clipped to and covers the provisional site without intentional overlaps.
All PCI scenarios preserve non-AI baseline/human alternative and degraded-mode city use.
UAR and live governance metrics remain unknown/null until real operating records exist.
Offline visual is local-only and declares the three required data-metrics.
Primary and English companion are present; figures/HTML/PDF counterparts generated in matching positions.
13 required chapters, 12 scenarios, 8 personas, 4 test scenarios, key-area logic, PCI, landmarks and operations are present.
Live OSM materialization completed (5532 usable features / 1898 building polygons); Microsoft current public index was queried and has no target partition. Candidate evidence remains non-statutory.
Organizer-named AI innovation index, talent density, output value, AI-industry-space scale and function mix are defined as auditable unknown/null metrics rather than fabricated values.
Zhongzhiyuan, AI Origin and Dazhongsi explicitly cover organizer-named mobility, renewal, culture/green-space and AI-industry deepening tasks as conceptual/professional follow-up items.

Annual activities, developer community operations, scenario opening, public experience route, international communication and attraction/conversion are explicitly addressed without claiming government commitments.
